sources.start: DESIGN.md: known departure position. This matches initialState's origin; resetting navigation uses this known point, never the live boat position.
sources.log: TUNING GUESS: signed forward speed log, 1.5% mean bias plus seeded +/-1% calibration variation and two slow 0.8% fractional noise components. No sideways velocity is measured. Smooth time-based error avoids frame-rate-dependent random walks.
sources.bearingStepDeg/minSightHorizontal: TUNING GUESS: half-degree sighting-compass graduation; reject nearly vertical aiming where horizontal bearing is undefined/unusable. Bearing uses actual camera world direction, including boat heel and pitch; no exact target bearing or automatic buoy identification.
sources.minFixAngleDeg/maxBearingAge/maxObservat: TUNING GUESS: reject crossings within 15 degrees of parallel/antiparallel, expire observations after 180 seconds, retain five sighting notes. Lines are advanced by accumulated logged motion to account for sailing between observations.
sources.visual: VISUAL ESTIMATE: physical lap chart follows the sailor's eye anchor, below and ahead of the eye, never camera look or screen coordinates. M releases the mouse without moving the chart or camera. Chart size, texture resolution, update interval, zoom limits, compass placement and sighting-device dimensions are visual/readability tuning. No full-body animation is added.
